scientific_integrity: The proof uses strict circular cosine compression and an exact trigonometric identity. Finite subset enumeration corroborates but does not replace the proof. Runner-up comparison is best-knowledge, with possible older unindexed polygonal-sum formulations.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted adjacent two-character Fourier band and observation masks of fixed size, 2<=k<=N-2. Does not address higher-dimensional Fourier bands, non-coprime gaps, or quantitative noise robustness.
title: The exact runner-up spectral concentration for two-character cyclic Fourier masks
